hints.title: Subsequence Frequency Uniformity
hints.text: In a good subsequence, every distinct character appears with the exact same positive frequency f.

hints.title: Combinatorial Choices per Character
hints.text: For a character appearing C times total, if C >= f, we can either omit it or choose f of its occurrences in C choose f ways.

hints.title: Aggregating Over Target Frequencies
hints.text: For each possible frequency f from 1 to max_count, multiply (1 + C choose f) over all eligible characters and subtract 1 for the empty set.

hints.title: Combinatorial Good Subsequence Counting Implementation

complexity.notes: Factorial table precomputation followed by evaluating 26 character choices across max_c frequencies.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Examining all 2^N subsequences directly causes exponential blowup.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(max_c) memory stores factorials and modular inverse lookup tables.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Groups subsequences by uniform character frequency f and applies combinations.
